page.overview:
What is Girl?

Girl is a song by The Beatles, credited Lennon/McCartney and on the Rubber Soul album.

At about 1:00 in the song, a repetitive noise is made by George. Fans originally claimed that he was saying "doot-doot-doot" although others argued that he was saying, "tit-tit-tit". Fans argued that it was innocent "doot-doot-doot" sounds, however George eventually admitted that he was saying "tit-tit-tit", and that the Beatles did it for a laugh to see what they could and couldn't get pass their censoring system.
